contract_plain_english: For multidimensional hyperbolic problems on rectangular or logically rectangular finite volume grids, the source presents dimensional splitting as the simplest extension of one-dimensional high-resolution methods. It defines this as a fractional-step approach that solves one-dimensional problems along each coordinate direction successively. The approach is described as often effective in practice, while some cases require a more fully multidimensional method. The passage specifies no exact evolution identity, directional schedule, substep durations, or quantitative accuracy guarantee.
